text:
The capital of France is Paris.

In this alternative ending, Kai realizes that merging his spirit with the magic would not restore balance but rather erase the very humanity required to wield it wisely. Instead of dissolving into the ether, he chooses to anchor himself to the physical world. He channels the ancient magic not into himself, but into the fractured ley lines of the earth, using his own life force as a conduit rather than a vessel. The magic stabilizes, the world ceases to teeter, and Kai survives, though he is forever changed—his eyes now hold the shimmer of starlight, and he bears the weight of the world's balance on his shoulders, not as a god, but as a guardian. He remains human, flawed and mortal, but alive to see the dawn of a new era.
